rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: FICOスコアを販売する提携先。3大信用情報機関でFICO売上の51%
relations.text_en: Distributes FICO scores; the three bureaus are 51% of FICO revenue

source.label: Fair Isaac 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: During fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, revenues generated from our agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax collectively accounted for 51%, 45% and 41% of our total revenues, respectively.

relations.text: クラウドサービスを購入し、ネットワーク・セキュリティの一部を委託
relations.text_en: Buys Google cloud services and outsources parts of its network and security

source.label: Equifax 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Under our agreement with Google, we have agreed to purchase cloud platform services and cloud marketplace software and we have outsourced certain areas of our network and security infrastructure.

companies.name: ヌー・ホールディングス
companies.sub: デジタル銀行(ブラジル)

relations.text: Equifax傘下Boa Vistaの分析を自社の与信実績の説明に使う
relations.text_en: Cites Equifax Boa Vista analysis of its credit performance

source.label: Nu Holdings 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: based on Equifax | Boa Vista analysis.

relations.text: ブラジルの信用情報会社を約8.7億ドルで完全子会社化(2023年8月)
relations.text_en: Bought the rest of the Brazilian credit bureau for about $870 million (August 2023)

source.label: Equifax 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On August 7, 2023, we acquired the remaining interest of our investment in BVS, a consumer and commercial credit information company in Brazil

companies.name: アプリス・インサイツ

relations.text: 身元調査データ会社を買収(社債の調達資金を充当)
relations.text_en: Acquired the background data company, funded in part by notes

source.label: Equifax 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: including the Company's acquisition of Appriss Insights.

companies.name: フード・インダストリー・クレジット・ビューロー

source.label: Equifax 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: During 2023, we acquired The Food Industry Credit Bureau and BVS within the International operating segment.

relations.text: TransUnionが10-Kで、競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: TransUnion names Equifax first among its competitors

source.label: TransUnion 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In our International segment, we generally compete with Equifax and Experian directly or indirectly through their subsidiaries or investments.

companies.name: ダン・アンド・ブラッドストリート

relations.text: D&Bが10-Kで、北米の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: D&B names Equifax among its main North American competitors

source.label: Dun & Bradstreet 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Experian and Creditsafe in Europe and Experian and Equifax in North America.

companies.name: ジェン・デジタル
companies.sub: 個人向けセキュリティ

relations.text: Gen Digitalが10-Kで、個人情報保護の主な競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Gen Digital lists Equifax first among identity protection competitors

source.label: Gen Digital 10-K(2025年3月期)
source.quote: Our principal competitors in this segment include credit bureaus such as Equifax, Experian and TransUnion

companies.name: クレジットリスクモニター

relations.text: CreditRiskMonitorが10-Kで、企業信用情報の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: CreditRiskMonitor names Equifax's commercial credit offerings as competition

source.label: CreditRiskMonitor 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: notably the commercial credit offerings of Experian plc and Equifax Inc.
